label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark leads U.S. Open
items.text: Wyndham Clark leads the U.S. Open at 6-under through 13 holes, with Scottie Scheffler, Tom Kim, and Sam Stevens tied at 1-under.

items.headline: Grehan leads British Amateur
items.text: Mid-amateur Stuart Grehan, 33, claimed the British Amateur title at Royal Liverpool, earning spots in the Open Championship, the Masters, and the U.S. Open.

items.headline: Chamblee critiques Woods' influence
items.text: Brandel Chamblee criticized Tiger Woods for normalizing on-course profanity and club-throwing, saying today's players owe fans more composure and praising new conduct rules.
